source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Nikhil Rao,

For your review, I've attached the English script for the first creative concept, which is now drafted. It draws on the reference videos you provided as well as additional research into high-performing Meta creatives in this market.

Instead of recreating the existing ad, I developed an original, story-driven direction centered on confidence, self-improvement, and emotional connection. The product is introduced naturally so the concept feels authentic and engaging.

We should first align on the creative direction, messaging, and story through this review. After approval, I'll adapt the script into natural Hindi for the voiceover, and only then move into production.

Please share your thoughts and let me know what you would like adjusted before I proceed to the next stage.

source_message.text: Compared with this version, you need to create something 25 times better. What you made feels very boring, has no viral quality, and resembles the same content already appearing all across meta.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Nikhil Rao,

Rather than editing the previous version, I've rebuilt the concept completely around your feedback. The result is a fast-paced, 45-second testimonial-style UGC ad featuring multiple Indian testimonials. It retains the same high-converting keywords and psychology without feeling like a copy of the winning creative.

The revised execution includes:

- A stronger and more direct hook

- A fresh concept instead of a copied reference

- Testimonial-style presentation

- Faster pacing designed for Meta

- Keywords centered on energy, confidence, stamina, and performance

- Indian actors, with visual flow and editing opportunities that suit the concept

Before I prepare the final production prompt and begin scene-by-scene execution, please review this version and confirm whether it aligns with the direction you want.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports completely rebuilding the concept as a fresh, fast-paced Meta-style execution in response to the prior feedback.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Bro, this material is still too generic and does not feel viral. I expected something better, but the hooks are not even matching the required standard; without matching them first, how can we improve on them?

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Nikhil Rao,

The first draft is attached for your review. It took a little longer than expected because I did not want to rush the work; both the visuals and voiceover needed to come together in an engaging, natural, and scroll-stopping way while remaining true to your reference style.

I also found that forcing the story into exactly 16 seconds made it feel rushed. To give the emotions, product reveal, and voiceover enough space, I extended the draft slightly to 22 seconds. I believe the added room creates a stronger, more natural viewing experience without losing the impact of a short-form ad.

Please share your feedback. I am happy to refine anything you would like changed, and I remain fully committed to making sure the final production satisfies you and achieves the outcome you envision.
